name: Aspect of the Wilds
duration: until you change it after a rest

modifiers.note: Climb Speed equal to your Speed
Swim Speed equal to your Speed
Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks; you can change your skin color

desc: Wild Heart: the aspect you chose — Owl (Darkvision 120 ft.), Panther (Climb Speed), Salmon (Swim Speed) or Chameleon (Advantage on Stealth).
